FAQ

Questions,
answered.

Can’t find yours? Ask us.

Ordering

How does the bundle deal work?

Put any 3 or more bandanas in your bag, in any mix of colours, and 15% comes off the bandanas automatically. You see the discount in your bag before you check out.

Do I need an account?

No. Fill in your delivery details at checkout and you are done. You get an order number to track it with.

Can I change or cancel my order?

Yes, until it ships. Message us with your order number as soon as you can and we will sort it out.

Delivery

Do you ship outside Pakistan?

Yes, to every country we can reach by tracked courier. International shipping is a flat $12 and takes about 7–14 working days.

How long does delivery take in Pakistan?

Usually 3–5 working days to any city in Pakistan. Delivery is Rs 250, and free on orders over Rs 8,000.

How do I track my order?

Use the order number from checkout (like FUD-1001) with your phone number on the Track your order page.

Payment

How do I pay in Pakistan?

Cash on delivery. You pay the rider in cash when your bandanas arrive; nothing is paid online.

How do I pay from abroad?

International orders are paid before they ship. After you order we send a secure payment link, and your bandanas are packed as soon as it is paid. Prices are in US dollars.

Why do you text me a code at checkout?

In Pakistan we confirm cash-on-delivery orders with a code sent to your mobile, so riders are not sent to fake orders. It takes a few seconds.

Product

What size are the bandanas?

Every bandana is a 55 × 55 cm (22") square, the classic size that ties round your head, neck or wrist.

What are they made of?

100% cotton with hemmed edges and a colourfast print.

How do I wash it?

Machine wash cold with similar colours, or hand wash. Line dry. Wash it alone the first time, as cotton can release a little colour.

What if I want to return it?

Unworn and unwashed bandanas can be exchanged within 7 days of delivery. Faulty items are always replaced. See Delivery & returns for how.
